## Aniimo Cheats — iOS Mod Menu

**Target Bundle ID:** `com.x.aniimos.ios`  
**Architecture:** `arm64` (Rootless) & `arm64e` (RootHide)

---

### ⚡ Main Features (Zero-Offset Encrypted xLua Engine)
- **God Mode** — No player or pet damage
- **Attack Multiplier (`1x – 20x`)** — Multi-hit per attack
- **Infinite Stamina** — Never drown or tire while sprinting, swimming, or gliding
- **Move Speed (`1.0x – 10.0x`)** — Boost walk, run, swim, and glide speed
- **Aniimo Vacuum** — Pull nearby wild Aniimo directly to your position
- **Vacuum Range (`5m – 60m`)** — Adjustable pull radius in meters
- **Anti-Debug & Stream-Cipher Memory Wipe** — Encrypted Lua payload with instant post-injection memory scrub

---

### 🛡️ Protection & Cloud Auto-Update
- **Cloud + On-Device Auto-Offset Engine** — Automatically resolves updated offsets across game updates without waiting for a new `.deb`
- **1-User License System** — Hardware UDID / Keychain device token binding via Hunter's license server
- **Glass UI Floating Mod Menu** — Draggable floating button, multi-tab layout, live sliders & persistent settings

**v1.1.2**
- Updated to streamlined Protected Encrypted xLua Engine with Anti-Debug & Memory Wipe
- Synced 1-User Device Token Lock & custom floating menu icon
